//exports: The stylesheet is this package's reason to exist, and an exports map is

esbuild and Angular's own builder all refuse a subpath it does not name.

in the tarball reachable by nobody until tools/verify-consumer-boundary.mjs
resolved a specifier against a packed tarball and said so.
